q: Center for the Study of New Testament Manuscripts
transcript:
The Center for the Study of New Testament Manuscripts (CSNTM) is a non-profit organization dedicated to digitally preserving surviving Greek New Testament manuscripts. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVxUfJ4gDLG0EQdcI5Iv7Rmh3-8md0NdN86ntHgvgShTe-qhlnkj-_zKGKNn9AwSGA0KoIFBF-astt84cDoDJgPCP4MOS4mI0NBw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVXpxRJsAh5jM5nposyHZjVMYnqUmieth6GJ6_MnTfeUqA9gCuRGcZ2z-XZnbBCtKFPPDOLds79bG8dfCn3Y9_xXLpVhPXks1_7lJetzaJiIrm2g)]
Key Details

* Founder: Dr. Daniel B. Wallace (founded in September 2002) [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFees8jE9wl9k3SfrmUfjxBogyQAcZw42d8Men72y926rB_kgJY7Kz0qr1pFbwpPYE0hhk-7_Nc5osKpqEGYIMzcLY96iJb8lLUASeyGBOP_q3JTvRIdALpGVwMy9Ail9P_3y82HSUfu_gDheFYB6IDZ9zMlvYt0jTXvlKXsCqMlGMnc), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVntVP-WfwgH7zQuFkvdJ0heNZqZ-8T6ypGT3Wi7ahBx0YcTe15C1lVi6Lkhv07_lOGYDdAlPiCeYNZDN9ZTlQvg5K-Ca20syHs6f7IN388UD6bzDXlxuloduPEqFsPabA4_aHTpcvy8wR)]
* Location: Plano, Texas [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFees8jE9wl9k3SfrmUfjxBogyQAcZw42d8Men72y926rB_kgJY7Kz0qr1pFbwpPYE0hhk-7_Nc5osKpqEGYIMzcLY96iJb8lLUASeyGBOP_q3JTvRIdALpGVwMy9Ail9P_3y82HSUfu_gDheFYB6IDZ9zMlvYt0jTXvlKXsCqMlGMnc)]
* Mission: To capture high-resolution digital photographs of ancient and medieval Greek New Testament manuscripts held in libraries, monasteries, and archives worldwide. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEB6zswFdGwc61wEbg86HJk7XKEahEEQhyAJkdE6w8THG8jF_7ubyLCI7dhfH8kB_f8jA-bd0KuTmhqjDED_H1Fmle3tYVDF6v2iw_xYK0RICg8fLXS1mKcg1APfy9ZkJiE7NtW_HhXBrJ8lrR70_M_2MI3aIMAAaFg31QBQ5HAm9XY19zFTyPZpBz06lI9), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVxUfJ4gDLG0EQdcI5Iv7Rmh3-8md0NdN86ntHgvgShTe-qhlnkj-_zKGKNn9AwSGA0KoIFBF-astt84cDoDJgPCP4MOS4mI0NBw)]
* Accessibility: Images are made freely available to scholars, researchers, and the public online. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVxUfJ4gDLG0EQdcI5Iv7Rmh3-8md0NdN86ntHgvgShTe-qhlnkj-_zKGKNn9AwSGA0KoIFBF-astt84cDoDJgPCP4MOS4mI0NBw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVXpxRJsAh5jM5nposyHZjVMYnqUmieth6GJ6_MnTfeUqA9gCuRGcZ2z-XZnbBCtKFPPDOLds79bG8dfCn3Y9_xXLpVhPXks1_7lJetzaJiIrm2g)]

Major Work & Achievements

* Digitization: Has collaborated with dozens of institutions across multiple continents, producing hundreds of thousands of high-resolution manuscript images. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVntVP-WfwgH7zQuFkvdJ0heNZqZ-8T6ypGT3Wi7ahBx0YcTe15C1lVi6Lkhv07_lOGYDdAlPiCeYNZDN9ZTlQvg5K-Ca20syHs6f7IN388UD6bzDXlxuloduPEqFsPabA4_aHTpcvy8wR), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFees8jE9wl9k3SfrmUfjxBogyQAcZw42d8Men72y926rB_kgJY7Kz0qr1pFbwpPYE0hhk-7_Nc5osKpqEGYIMzcLY96iJb8lLUASeyGBOP_q3JTvRIdALpGVwMy9Ail9P_3y82HSUfu_gDheFYB6IDZ9zMlvYt0jTXvlKXsCqMlGMnc)]
* Discoveries: Has identified nearly 90 previously unknown or uncatalogued Greek New Testament manuscripts. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEB6zswFUeDA_sb7LSOIV4UjT0xLrmNbHPzBNpPCs3wRffOHonb3oBb71XZZJuRGrNr2MEq38GF4bfQmQEsApH5TvUKlp1i2dft2ToBl9tnfpZm1EWU8NS2m4EaSab0jduFqVXS2HCOfsMAes8nIf9BkfSn2g9J5qD2pHHbyfaoxYjfNQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVntVP-WfwgH7zQuFkvdJ0heNZqZ-8T6ypGT3Wi7ahBx0YcTe15C1lVi6Lkhv07_lOGYDdAlPiCeYNZDN9ZTlQvg5K-Ca20syHs6f7IN388UD6bzDXlxuloduPEqFsPabA4_aHTpcvy8wR)]
* Digital Library: You can explore their collections directly through the [Center for the Study of New Testament Manuscripts](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVxUfJ4gDLG0EQdcI5Iv7Rmh3-8md0NdN86ntHgvgShTe-qhlnkj-_zKGKNn9AwSGA0KoIFBF-astt84cDoDJgPCP4MOS4mI0NBw) website. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVxUfJ4gDLG0EQdcI5Iv7Rmh3-8md0NdN86ntHgvgShTe-qhlnkj-_zKGKNn9AwSGA0KoIFBF-astt84cDoDJgPCP4MOS4mI0NBw)]

The Oxyrhynchus Papyri are a massive collection of ancient manuscripts discovered in the garbage dumps of [Oxyrhynchus](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV1fJTkWvepNpdXcz1FTiTgD2TzJwnIKqlxQFWjqxxST5AeBjCcgJmhPj-Yeh05uZsMeRxIHIalxaCwxJ87W6W-qZRqSMOxT4Ur_-Oy_ULiJ4bJ0OVBS0Zjyw_aPuj2G39H4nt) (modern Bahnasa, Egypt) by Oxford classicists Bernard Grenfell and Arthur Hunt between 1896 and 1907. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHrOzAVWTfiKDhi_GJUj_uCo4kUTMWJJXuVSBQUu_Lg7Xas6cMOsaeYL9aDLy_7Jt2NwHGqf99n5gM4jYe68B1BQT0NTj1hYis8EJ5-zVK9I8hr9HFxQ7v5dLbddg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVHKYeH9MMOplsy2m6M44I_4dCdnkJnBpHYOOwiByTHyQ4i_srIQAehR0skIX88lDj2lRGXN1jGRnbOlgKOBEQHQYTsDWaMSohG_vs1oDa7QMj2izXiybQ-EGriN_4cGfTQlCl)]
Key Facts

* The Collection: Housed primarily at the University of Oxford and managed by the [Egypt Exploration Society (EES)](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVE-J-BtE30aDuAYi0uEyXPmirrIaBMLmyKzpD07kyURlmolMbCscrpm40yzKQJKL7O40kms8UP2V7SedqBYyQjJ4_UJOsZZId4RrYO6yNyeJRCPkvRkVZygiyzBuffcQq), it is the largest archive of its kind in the world, containing an estimated 500,000 fragments. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVE-J-BtE30aDuAYi0uEyXPmirrIaBMLmyKzpD07kyURlmolMbCscrpm40yzKQJKL7O40kms8UP2V7SedqBYyQjJ4_UJOsZZId4RrYO6yNyeJRCPkvRkVZygiyzBuffcQq)]
* Time Period: The texts date from the 3rd century BCE (Ptolemaic period) through the 7th century CE (early Islamic period). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV1fJTkWvepNpdXcz1FTiTgD2TzJwnIKqlxQFWjqxxST5AeBjCcgJmhPj-Yeh05uZsMeRxIHIalxaCwxJ87W6W-qZRqSMOxT4Ur_-Oy_ULiJ4bJ0OVBS0Zjyw_aPuj2G39H4nt)]
* Languages: Most texts are in Greek, with others written in Latin, ancient Egyptian, Coptic, Arabic, Hebrew, and Aramaic. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV1fJTkWvepNpdXcz1FTiTgD2TzJwnIKqlxQFWjqxxST5AeBjCcgJmhPj-Yeh05uZsMeRxIHIalxaCwxJ87W6W-qZRqSMOxT4Ur_-Oy_ULiJ4bJ0OVBS0Zjyw_aPuj2G39H4nt), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVE-J-BtE30aDuAYi0uEyXPmirrIaBMLmyKzpD07kyURlmolMbCscrpm40yzKQJKL7O40kms8UP2V7SedqBYyQjJ4_UJOsZZId4RrYO6yNyeJRCPkvRkVZygiyzBuffcQq)]
* Content Mix:
   * 90% are public and private administrative or daily-life documents (tax receipts, census lists, legal contracts, school lessons, and personal letters).
   * 10% are literary and religious works, including lost plays, classical poetry (Sappho, Pindar), early Christian gospels, and biblical fragments (such as Papyrus 52 and the Gospel of Thomas). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV3AkYZZ6_E9c1Z1gK8am8fB58ergTxfRgVZdVFAKTSgp8ZAxmxuxaV2yOT3rHjRT-mKnbopypuYgCFLYYsn-Rc5heeiE0xYyBE9qybVBA4T2_MBhd9jdiPE6VJrW7ayvXEYb0), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVl2E1gpiHyEMJ18-sHk5UsROGGNTpRBLADPBaGjg31HFKL1iPGqcKKU2dH2YBuM5N2HbPVzSsPQfH9a_KSflpHvP9tYntDxdBTpoKHSTgb7RihDcHQIA4vwpYP5bB1gaBPBGc_A), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV1fJTkWvepNpdXcz1FTiTgD2TzJwnIKqlxQFWjqxxST5AeBjCcgJmhPj-Yeh05uZsMeRxIHIalxaCwxJ87W6W-qZRqSMOxT4Ur_-Oy_ULiJ4bJ0OVBS0Zjyw_aPuj2G39H4nt)]
* Publication Status: Scholars have continuously transcribed and published the texts in a multi-volume series since 1898 (reaching over 80 volumes), which still represents only a small fraction of the total find. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAVRaXaArOZMpQWIg9J5-5JgWj3zvaw_ZzEK8hI3V9WyUIHiN_x-yQ6uObIEio0kxgYXFEAkQEoZX7Ew0bbHKkll5BzMnV9AUpeNoYnqjKmM39IPpHjwfuyGXU4flgG9r_wi7EkR-P2), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHrOzAVWTfiKDhi_GJUj_uCo4kUTMWJJXuVSBQUu_Lg7Xas6cMOsaeYL9aDLy_7Jt2NwHGqf99n5gM4jYe68B1BQT0NTj1hYis8EJ5-zVK9I8hr9HFxQ7v5dLbddg)]

The term Bodmer Lab most commonly refers to one of three distinct entities depending on the context:
1. The Bodmer Lab (Digital Library & Archives) — University of Geneva

* What it is: A research and digitization project partnering the [University of Geneva](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVyU3u3VhyXsOCcXuKMtMUR4njVLqtnQVQH8-LoOMMKh09r9mp9JWludo4gPj91DKcPDy81Cs3zc1l_7a631tndXPi_hXRHZe7t2nh2mpX9uZ0AkwEQldqbmd7U7kYm3fhhbg), the Martin Bodmer Foundation, and the Fondation Ernst and Lucie Schmidheiny. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVyU3u3VhyXsOCcXuKMtMUR4njVLqtnQVQH8-LoOMMKh09r9mp9JWludo4gPj91DKcPDy81Cs3zc1l_7a631tndXPi_hXRHZe7t2nh2mpX9uZ0AkwEQldqbmd7U7kYm3fhhbg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXgHrOzAVY_pGYSC7fl07R9VpKbiKwbSGxkqpbsySv6uDViih-Say7FNBOs4-dWaJgfQPjze_ObnEvEpjm0shRO69OavP5JGYnf5JJdCQ3XG9YlxZjWfBQOrD4HQuoKc)]
* Focus: Digitizing rare books, manuscripts, world literature spanning 3,000 years, and historical items like the [Bodmer Papyri](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVSG7wEtIqnrmAea5ipz6ccvR6NakDihPLjsohU8ElLTInzvRjAGA98xFYq0ZE2S6as6llRV1pdD-j39KcekCdNNgprOegPtFfTYQusNbTevWKuTvmMRLQsOn9mtRmK8nBXt2Q) (early Christian and classical texts). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVSG7wEtIqnrmAea5ipz6ccvR6NakDihPLjsohU8ElLTInzvRjAGA98xFYq0ZE2S6as6llRV1pdD-j39KcekCdNNgprOegPtFfTYQusNbTevWKuTvmMRLQsOn9mtRmK8nBXt2Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVyU3u3VhyXsOCcXuKMtMUR4njVLqtnQVQH8-LoOMMKh09r9mp9JWludo4gPj91DKcPDy81Cs3zc1l_7a631tndXPi_hXRHZe7t2nh2mpX9uZ0AkwEQldqbmd7U7kYm3fhhbg), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXgHrOzAVY_pGYSC7fl07R9VpKbiKwbSGxkqpbsySv6uDViih-Say7FNBOs4-dWaJgfQPjze_ObnEvEpjm0shRO69OavP5JGYnf5JJdCQ3XG9YlxZjWfBQOrD4HQuoKc)]
* Website: [The Bodmer Lab at UNIGE](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVyU3u3VhyXsOCcXuKMtMUR4njVLqtnQVQH8-LoOMMKh09r9mp9JWludo4gPj91DKcPDy81Cs3zc1l_7a631tndXPi_hXRHZe7t2nh2mpX9uZ0AkwEQldqbmd7U7kYm3fhhbg) [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVyU3u3VhyXsOCcXuKMtMUR4njVLqtnQVQH8-LoOMMKh09r9mp9JWludo4gPj91DKcPDy81Cs3zc1l_7a631tndXPi_hXRHZe7t2nh2mpX9uZ0AkwEQldqbmd7U7kYm3fhhbg)]

2. The Bodmer Lab (Cardiovascular Research) — Sanford Burnham Prebys

* What it is: A scientific research laboratory led by Rolf Bodmer, Ph.D., at the Sanford Burnham Prebys Medical Discovery Institute. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVNA-hTvR0x3I7dkE6F-PcRT_2SEH7FGDhPukzlXQ9WLoKIWTzo094zrdRN8wUTLA5CtA2jJKhdJo9DwnZTaaosQkFC7nWc8vq0w), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVzkM9gT9Y1zPo-RVC8XIdEU-WLMRXzhWFRSGmmbFsQl8Zj1QfaDzLmmfQHwtCpSrGbmtQGBr96wTqpVUMuXI-GE69mmTwN0LGLDVLpdI2Yco5ZvlM19L9nOUiBw)]
* Focus: Investigating the cellular and molecular basis of heart development, organ formation, aging, and adult heart function using the Drosophila melanogaster (fruit fly) model system—including studies on sleep, hypoxia, and microgravity ("Space Flies"). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVKPcQ3XXaK_jN7W7OlnlDi6NoNJZGPd6LeQJGx3gvNE1MYY8ScJG9liWTGemX2pQov9SRKtvS_84oU2rXYRkK2N7OVVTbhYCEE1Qk96xl_uQSCLpdt6_MUZet8Gp0rOC9h0_XFp6yMg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVaMIdevrXRbcoxY8YIPAklglw4LtCMYI3S29CG6Yh959S5KEwY3japVLzLu6FuH1_iODTirzIYzk9PHnu1uGQGEuznk4PsTAI2A4NgZCnfE6WmbQdWTUKPoXAgWurxQ), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVNA-hTvR0x3I7dkE6F-PcRT_2SEH7FGDhPukzlXQ9WLoKIWTzo094zrdRN8wUTLA5CtA2jJKhdJo9DwnZTaaosQkFC7nWc8vq0w)]
* Website: [Bodmer Lab Official Site](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVNA-hTvR0x3I7dkE6F-PcRT_2SEH7FGDhPukzlXQ9WLoKIWTzo094zrdRN8wUTLA5CtA2jJKhdJo9DwnZTaaosQkFC7nWc8vq0w) [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTgHrOzAVNA-hTvR0x3I7dkE6F-PcRT_2SEH7FGDhPukzlXQ9WLoKIWTzo094zrdRN8wUTLA5CtA2jJKhdJo9DwnZTaaosQkFC7nWc8vq0w)]

3. The Bodmer Laboratories — University of Salford

* What it is: A state-of-the-art, purpose-built integrated teaching and research science facility named after geneticist Sir Walter Bodmer. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVa99Ikkv8tycMSevsuFVddzm02ehzBo9KoFP2VPcodoLx28MZeHt2760AWPeuj7o6SKgOCqIjj739EeBgiw02MIxMszYifA-SzntbVgeaYZFHjik-XzVu-spKgG1G3qIl-oAk9OmpZA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAV4PyxaDJFOj6kMDbgVT9nfdpNlEe2vIl2QQ4RGg8pyC8IYp2f985JSblkpraA_jjjgReHUzMy4xdFMssu1QbMtB23q0_SK3ZXva5Va8C20Ud_gQfNi0HM-I1flEWORA)]
* Focus: Equipping students with industry-standard tech in areas like cell culture, mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF, LC, GC), FTIR/FTNMR spectroscopy, and electron microscopy. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVa99Ikkv8tycMSevsuFVddzm02ehzBo9KoFP2VPcodoLx28MZeHt2760AWPeuj7o6SKgOCqIjj739EeBgiw02MIxMszYifA-SzntbVgeaYZFHjik-XzVu-spKgG1G3qIl-oAk9OmpZA)]
* Website: [University of Salford Bodmer Labs](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVa99Ikkv8tycMSevsuFVddzm02ehzBo9KoFP2VPcodoLx28MZeHt2760AWPeuj7o6SKgOCqIjj739EeBgiw02MIxMszYifA-SzntbVgeaYZFHjik-XzVu-spKgG1G3qIl-oAk9OmpZA) [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVa99Ikkv8tycMSevsuFVddzm02ehzBo9KoFP2VPcodoLx28MZeHt2760AWPeuj7o6SKgOCqIjj739EeBgiw02MIxMszYifA-SzntbVgeaYZFHjik-XzVu-spKgG1G3qIl-oAk9OmpZA)]

q: Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library
transcript:
The Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library is a free, searchable online database created by the Israel Antiquities Authority in partnership with Google. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAVYlALljpUq-NiyAQLmUSeB87yOag-XmaHg4Ehu-WC_yKXawZYpSvIID_Un2eHM5YQzBUAp00-n_6VPqjvUCF6L4YyYn84BJSMEY98qdWY14Q5hLn3RPXFD8kgKmjpqVX7ljXv5VWu), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVyZvLPQGFYg5b51PZRc3tcverkz0si_i-rvYCrg9dCJNENluzOdkwoOHX-DtzixRkAoCRwaTmwLKRD7TXA6DqESNvmhFmDjBoQuldhyhOQ3uJ5r4_2N457drXpji0SWSJ)]
Key Features

* High-Resolution Imaging: Uses multi-spectral imaging capturing 12 different wavelengths (visible and near-infrared) to reveal faded ink and hidden text. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVw_0BD6rGL8545DtWoxtMppwgoNuTkTIIcLynu9FZDKhIziI3oHcE-tZTXnucU_iclOgV4PuMv0-6NyYsY4xkLujNfUdAoaxQrmBdeCCYNVjz7IBNpw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVOnVkjjOuoHoKfGugH5dLushSh3OMFqL3V2UxQbfTXetCs-fQpgUrEvPA1vUSKITMj_2u0ry8geVZTx2odFU3UxW6Iaru6uIWK2VCYPrdvAGz35VccGyz63k0j41BGq0Vb9c)]
* Massive Archive: Preserves thousands of ancient scroll fragments and hundreds of manuscripts discovered in the Judean Desert between 1947 and the early 1960s. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEB6zswFYSDybznhsTnBn8TMVRtNOn5ysCSpB_xR4mcbwNaPvXUBhH04V8s8Jva0Nu8YJO9BqvimKjcdwCr9k8oFaGO6cVJeLVt05uPuD30w9ujXktLAMFOZGc2qiy528JpA6NoGF7XjLdG2uLSGGRGM2T6b86CsrBD-V3ZDL4RRUf7mSLqa0XcCbMe), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFU71UR1puU27BAGjNinCBBgLJIHeplPtqibYEhTVIeGVMdKQiVaXI4AcEozGRWdTPlthEBHI4dJoq_euF5_TflAqRJV_5WRyCuf3dT45uV6s26ytYQNyiLl5_Q9SzBQ8Q18OXqNoFH8PQ05IFOTFsGmgnRkqeZ4szNBIhA)]
* Search & Filter Tools: Allows users to search and sort by archaeological site, language (Hebrew, Aramaic, Greek), material, historical period, and manuscript type. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEB6zswFYSDybznhsTnBn8TMVRtNOn5ysCSpB_xR4mcbwNaPvXUBhH04V8s8Jva0Nu8YJO9BqvimKjcdwCr9k8oFaGO6cVJeLVt05uPuD30w9ujXktLAMFOZGc2qiy528JpA6NoGF7XjLdG2uLSGGRGM2T6b86CsrBD-V3ZDL4RRUf7mSLqa0XcCbMe), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAVYlALljpUq-NiyAQLmUSeB87yOag-XmaHg4Ehu-WC_yKXawZYpSvIID_Un2eHM5YQzBUAp00-n_6VPqjvUCF6L4YyYn84BJSMEY98qdWY14Q5hLn3RPXFD8kgKmjpqVX7ljXv5VWu)]
* P.A.M. Negatives: Includes digital scans of historic Palestine Archaeological Museum photographic negatives from the 1950s. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVw_0BD6rGL8545DtWoxtMppwgoNuTkTIIcLynu9FZDKhIziI3oHcE-tZTXnucU_iclOgV4PuMv0-6NyYsY4xkLujNfUdAoaxQrmBdeCCYNVjz7IBNpw)]

You can access and explore the collection directly through the [Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAVltqqeB-sSxPe8azfOV1MUfhHuKLjOW7mQHWTu8IXf66w5w2W2U4kwDHuC1AtHiqiygHZEwm4OVoSuM4UQGzO2KsWR-fKOIuEahUQ-M6ol0CxjCoV-5oSA-yWZxI2Y1e0ez4).

[Early Christian Writings: The Apostolic Fathers](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEB6zswFcDMl4hq4b-fvSz_WUi5TJf0dspFUlYh67bvegx6f_Vi2fsSHxN8uF27UFlGpDFGtVy7_d0d7WrCj9cIBKd_dM8NNfy2u1OsXodfDVdQIgD9nnQbDIY98vRwXu59zMxucbBIspXcuLmr6meuf2xirxZNk5qOflhf6QOgFDb1Udtp5K8) is a collection of late first- and second-century letters and theological treatises translated by Maxwell Staniforth and revised by [Andrew Louth](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEB6zswFSWp1RQv6XsAQaR8Xqeq-T9S4f7CFWw50Ex-MzkvgjOtxry0iYidWR-rlbZ9PzVraqkHQ0F1UwDOJ3bbG4suQ0aS6pF63p7a9KbCyfvg0qe5HLYtGKItxdGE-I4ypaBpxwULwVbaIF3tXGL8yaXxwSoZIzgWApRENd3_2fH4y-EJS9aTklQDyw).
Book Overview

* Publisher: [Penguin Classics](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEB6zswFWE-5Z1c5Gi6HN5y_iVPvSoH0gmVgbbUHQpXm0PasBCR9H3I7dFFt-X_-8VmNKoI5nx1FJ2zmUXcnshG3uJ3w4MtdUvY8j9x3gft0t-SqsTHs_JZz0BD-ia8ZNFWY6145anqNbtDKhJRrdAtJtLejQ7WwrdaXJUeNYBqk8ZHTp4)
* Length: 208 pages
* Publication Date: September 1, 1987 (Revised Edition)
* Price:
 Around $17.00 (Paperback) or $10.99 (eBook/Kindle)
Amazon.com +3

Included Works

* First Epistle of Bishop Clement of Rome (plea for harmony)
* Seven Epistles of Ignatius of Antioch
* The Epistle of Polycarp
* The Epistle of Barnabas
* The Didache (Teaching of the Twelve Apostles)

Core Theme
The texts provide a first-hand look at the emerging traditions, organization, and daily struggles of the infant Christian church as it interacted with and grew out of its parent religion, Judaism.
